subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers land, rewrite, or close the open busy-state recovery PR before resolving this issue?
rationale: The issue has a plausible partial fix on main, but the open closing PR still owns broader active-run snapshot and recovery semantics that are conflicting and proof-gated.

options.title: Rewrite or replace on current main
options.body: Preserve the useful recovery intent while using current `ui/src/pages/chat`, filtered active-run, and live protocol-package contracts before closing this issue.

options.title: Revive the existing PR
options.body: Ask the contributor or an adopter to rebase the branch, resolve the review blockers, and add live Dashboard tab-return proof.

options.title: Accept partial mitigation
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the current `hasActiveRun` Stop/Queue recovery satisfies the product contract without active run snapshot adoption.

recommendation.title: Rewrite or replace on current main
recommendation.body: Preserve the useful recovery intent while using current `ui/src/pages/chat`, filtered active-run, and live protocol-package contracts before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main UI work touched the chat composer surface and current-head area that would carry the decision or replacement path.
